content:
incident-bot: :bangbang: ALARM: Spike in websocket streaming failures for enterprise tenant Greenline Health (vpc tenant: greenline-vpc-3). Observed at 14:04 UTC: streaming disconnect rate 9.8% over 3m (SLO target <1%).
eng-oncall: on it. seeing repeated ECONNRESET and 502s proxied from the ws layer to Greenline's app gateway.
ira-b: I can confirm traffic is being served by dedicated pool greenline-dedicated-a in us-west-2. No model CPU/GPU OOMs.
support-greenline: Greenline reports their client SDK started an aggressive immediate-retry loop at ~14:02 which may be amplifying failures. They asked for urgent mitigation.
eng-oncall: logs: sequence -> client reconnect -> proxy accept -> upstream reset -> client reconnect again. Backpressure loop.
sam-ops: autoscaler metrics show steady state 85% connection slots used, then a jump to 98% at 14:03. Autoscale tried adding nodes but policy cooldown prevented full capacity.
infra-bot: Proposed fast actions: (1) temporary scale +3 replicas to greenline-dedicated-a, (2) raise ws proxy keepalive/idle to 180s, (3) set per-tenant retry throttling at ingress to drop excessive reconnects. Need operator confirmation for shared fallback.
maya-r: Note: Greenline is enterprise VPC with dedicated pool for PHI traffic; fallback to shared is restricted. Support confirm allowed routes?
support-greenline: Legal: only non-PHI telemetry (/health, /metrics, /status) can go to shared; anything touching patient data must stay on dedicated.
eng-oncall: implementing scale: ```redwoodctl pool update --name greenline-dedicated-a --replicas +3 --reason "mitigate reconnect storm"```
infra-bot: scale request acknowledged. ETA ~150s for new nodes to register.
eng-oncall: applying ingress guardrail: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: per-tenant-retry-throttle
  namespace: redwood
data:
  greenline: "max_retries=5;window_s=60;backoff=exponential"
EOF
```
sam-ops: throttling in place. Also bumping connection queue length on the proxy from 500 -> 1200 to avoid early drops.
eng-oncall: support to Greenline: please patch client to exponential backoff with jitter and cap retries to 5. We've applied server-side throttles but client cooperation reduces impact.
support-greenline: sent note to Greenline ops at 14:13 UTC. They are deploying a client hotfix to limit retries and add jitter.
eng-oncall: infra-bot reports new nodes healthy, connection acceptance improved. Error rate decreased from 9.8% -> 2.5% over 6 minutes.
ira-b: still seeing occasional long-lived stream resets (>8m sessions). Hypothesis: default idle timeout at ws-proxy was low causing mid-session resets when client reconnect floods cause queueing.
oncall-day: for dedicated pools serving enterprise data, we should confirm our default ws idle timeout is enterprise-friendly; maybe 300s for VPC tenants.
eng-oncall: can temporarily set idle to 300s for greenline-dedicated-a. Doing: ```kubectl patch configmap ws-proxy -n redwood -p '{"data":{"idle_timeout":"300s"}}'```
infra-bot: patch applied. Rolling restart scheduled with graceful connection drain to avoid disrupting active sessions.
maya-r: because we changed timeout and added capacity, we should avoid shifting traffic to shared except for allowed endpoints. Create route filter for '/health' and '/metrics' only.
eng-oncall: adding route rule: ```redwoodctl route set --tenant greenline --rule "path_prefix:/health,/metrics -> pool:shared-nonphi"```
support-greenline: confirmed that route change is acceptable for telemetry only. sent final approval at 14:22 UTC.
eng-oncall: monitoring: 5xx near-term trending down to 0.9% after throttles, scaling, and timeout changes. Client retry volume reduced by ~70% as per ingress metrics.
ira-b: capture for post-incident: autoscaler cooldown prevented fast enough scaling; we need warm pool standby for dedicated customers above threshold. Also consider default ws idle too short for some long-lived enterprise sessions.
biz-ops: I'll prepare customer comms; need a short summary of actions and confirmation no PHI left the dedicated pool.
support-greenline: Greenline confirms no PHI routed to shared pool; they report user sessions stabilized and fewer reconnections after their client patch.
eng-oncall: follow-ups: 1) add warm standby nodes for enterprise dedicated pools when baseline >70%, 2) implement automatic per-source-IP retry dampening at edge, 3) increase default enterprise ws idle timeout config and make it configurable per-tenant at onboarding, 4) update enterprise runbook for client retry guidance.
oncall-day: I'll own #1 and #2; ira will take #3; maya will update runbook.
eng-oncall: creating incident ticket and brief: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0461. Pager will be cleared once monitoring stable for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0461 created (P2). Assigned: eng-oncall, infra, support-greenline.
eng-oncall: clearing active pager. Leaving thread for daytime watch and postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager cleared at 14:35 UTC by eng-oncall.
